summary.text: Jason O'Dell is the Constitution Party candidate for Utah House of Representatives District 1 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Thomas Peterson (R) and Chris Reid (D).
He advanced from the Constitution Party convention on April 25, 2026, and the June 23 primary was canceled.
